coding_practice.title: Day of the Year
coding_practice.description: Given a string date representing a Gregorian calendar date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, return the day number of the year.

examples.explanation: Given date is the 9th day of the year in 2019.

coding_practice.constraints:
date.length == 10
date[4] == date[7] == '-', and all other date[i]'s are digits
date represents a calendar date between Jan 1st, 1900 and Dec 31st, 2019.
coding_practice.solution:
class Solution(object):
    def dayOfYear(self, date):
        """
        :type date: str
        :rtype: int
        """
        year, month, day = map(int, date.split('-'))
        days_in_month = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
        
        # Leap year check
        if (year % 4 == 0 and year % 100 != 0) or (year % 400 == 0):
            days_in_month[1] = 29
        
        return sum(days_in_month[:month-1]) + day
coding_practice.explanation:
1. 將輸入字串拆分成年、月、日。
2. 建立每個月份的天數列表 days_in_month。
3. 判斷是否為閏年，如是則二月天數設為 29。
4. 計算前面月份的總天數加上當月天數，即為該日期在該年的第幾天。
